41 AO No.151 of 2026
Satish Kumar ........Appellant
v.
Mohit Agarwal and Others ......Respondents
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Avidit Noliyal, Advocate for the 
appellant.
Heard. 
Admit.
Issue notices to the respondents, 
returnable within six weeks.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Let call for the lower court record.
List this matter for final hearing on 
20.08.2026.
Heard on Stay Application, IA No.1 of 
2026
It is the case of the appellant that he is 
plaintiff, who had filed a suit for cancellation of 
sale deed, which was decreed, but in the 
appeal, the matter has been remanded. 
Having heard, as an interim measure, till 
the next date of listing, the effect and operation 
of the impugned judgment and order dated 
21.02.2026, passed in Civil Appeal No.42 of 
2024, Mohit Agrawal v. Satish Kumar, by the 
court of First Additional District Judge, 
Haridwar, shall remain in abeyance. 
The stay application stands disposed of, 
accordingly. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
18.06.2026
RV
